description: Search Standard Blanks' blank apparel by keywords and filters. Returns up to 20 products with name, brand, slug, the lowest single-unit price ("from" price, in cents), availability, image and product page URL. When the query names a color or size, matchedColors lists the colors of that style that match (best first) and url opens the page on that color; an empty matchedColors for a query that named a color means that style is not sold in it. signal reports typo corrections and any words the search had to drop. Use the slug with get_product.

cheaper_than.description: A style's slug: the comparable styles priced below it.

decoration.description: Only styles rated good or best for this decoration method (screen print, DTG, embroidery, sublimation, heat-transfer vinyl, discharge, DTF).

max_price.description: Highest single-unit price, in US dollars.

min_price.description: Lowest single-unit price, in US dollars.

query.description: Keywords: brand, style number or product words, e.g. 'heavyweight hoodie' or 'bella canvas 3001'.

similar_to.description: A style's slug: list the styles comparable to it (same garment, other brands and price tiers), leaving it out. "alternative to gildan 18500" in `query` does the same.

size.description: Only styles offered in this size.

sort.description: Order of results. Default: relevance with a query, popular without one.

weight.description: Fabric weight band (ultralight 0-4 oz, light 4-5 oz, standard 5-6 oz, mid-heavy 6-7 oz, heavy 7-9 oz, heavyweight 9+ oz).

youth_and_adult.description: Only styles a team can order in both kids' and adult sizes: one style whose sizes span both, or one of a manufacturer's matching youth/adult pair (e.g. Gildan 5000 and 5000B).

name: search_catalog
title: Search the catalog
